title: Make Confirm reservation a keyboard-focusable native button

rounds.summary:
# Improvement — Confirm reservation is keyboard-reachable

## Changed behavior
- On the Review page, **Confirm reservation** is now a native `<button type="button">` in the sequential Tab order. It receives visible focus after **Edit meeting name** (and in reverse with Shift+Tab) and activates with **Enter** and **Space**, completing the booking to the confirmation view.
- Before, it was a `<span class="primary" … role="button" tabindex="-1">`: `tabindex="-1"` removed it from the Tab order, and a span never fires `click` on Enter/Space, matching the observed finding (Tab cycled past it, Enter left the page unchanged, Space scrolled).

## Rationale (source-linked)
- `finding-210d2e86-9bd6-4376-8cda-e94c8d60a42c-0`: Tab moved from Edit meeting name to an unfocused step and wrapped to the logo; Shift+Tab returned to Edit meeting name; Enter/Space did not confirm.
- Charter `gather-keyboard-booking` v3 + persona `gather-keyboard`: required booking controls should receive keyboard focus and activate with standard keys; keyboard-only completion is the success criterion.
- `DEMO_FIXTURE.md` confirms the span was the deliberately seeded defect.

## Changed files
- [app.js](app.js): `review()` — replaced the Confirm reservation `span` (`role="button" tabindex="-1"`) with `<button type="button" class="primary" id="confirm-reservation" data-action="confirm">`. Same id, class, and `data-action="confirm"`, so the existing `bind()` click handler and `confirmReservation()` flow (including the `button.disabled` guard, previously a no-op on a span) work unchanged. No styling changes needed: `styles.css` already styles `.primary` and `button:focus-visible`.

## Checks performed
- Read `app.js`, `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `DEMO_FIXTURE.md`; located the single `tabindex` occurrence (line 56) and confirmed no other `role="button"` spans remain.
- Verified by inspection that the new button keeps the same `data-action` click path and gains native Tab focus, focus-visible outline, and Enter/Space activation.
- No tests were run (shell execution is disabled in this session; browser retesting happens separately).

Possível obstáculo observado

Observação: Using only Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, and typing into the focused field, I selected Atlas (12 seats, projector, $280 all-in, within the $350 budget), entered 'Quarterly planning', and reached the Review page showing Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, 12 people, projector included, and $280 total. On Review, Tab moved through logo, Our spaces, My reservations, Choose another room, and Edit meeting name, then showed no visible focus and cycled back to the logo; Enter and Space at that position did not confirm (Space only scrolled), and Shift+Tab from the logo landed on Edit meeting name rather than Confirm reservation. No visible confirmation was reached.

Interpretação simulada: Gather supports keyboard navigation with clear focus through landing, Atlas room selection, meeting-name entry, and review, but the final 'Confirm reservation' control was not reached by Tab, reverse Tab, Enter, or Space. The persona therefore could not independently complete a reservation that otherwise matched all requirements.

Limites: Pointer activation of 'Confirm reservation' was not tested because the charter required keyboard-only interaction. Whether focus at the no-outline position rested on a hidden page element or outside the page content is not established; what is established is that neither Enter nor Space confirmed from there and reverse Tab landed on 'Edit meeting name'.

Capturas indicadas: #34, #44, #46, #48, #50, #52, #54, #56. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.

findings.title: Confirm reservation is not reachable by Tab or Shift+Tab on the Review page
findings.observation: On the Review page, forward Tab moved through the logo, Our spaces, My reservations, Choose another room, and Edit meeting name (screenshots 36-44), then left no visible focus anywhere (46) and looped back to the logo (48). findings.title: Confirm reservation is not reachable by Tab or Shift+Tab on the Review page
findings.observation: On the Review page, forward Tab moved through the logo, Our spaces, My reservations, Choose another room, and Edit meeting name (screenshots 36-44), then left no visible focus anywhere (46) and looped back to the logo (48). A second Tab from Edit meeting name again left no visible focus (52). Enter at that stop changed nothing (54), and Space scrolled the page instead of activating a button (56), after which Tab returned to the logo (58). Shift+Tab from the logo landed on Edit meeting name, not Confirm reservation (50). Confirm reservation was therefore never shown as focused and was never activated by keyboard.
findings.expected: The required Confirm reservation control should receive visible keyboard focus in the Tab order and activate with Enter or Space, as the earlier Choose Atlas and Review booking controls did.
findings.expectedSource: Saved charter: required booking controls should receive keyboard focus and activate with standard keys; persona declared keyboard-only access requirement. Other controls in this flow visibly met that pattern in screenshots 16 and 32.
findings.personaComment: I could review everything, but I could not reach Confirm reservation with my keyboard, so I am stuck at the last step.
findings.interpretation: A keyboard-only user can prepare and review a correct reservation but cannot independently complete it, because the final required action is outside the reachable focus order.
findings.uncertainty: Pointer operation of Confirm reservation was not tested because this journey was keyboard-only. The evidence does not establish whether the unmarked Tab stop had invisible focus on another element, only that no focus was visible and Enter/Space did not confirm.
